# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Port to 26.4-snapshot-3, round 2: what replaced the members the mod's code still uses.
# Block sounds are a registry of sound sets since 26.4-snapshot-3.
sig net.minecraft.world.level.block.sounds.BlockSoundSet
sig net.minecraft.world.level.block.sounds.BlockSoundSets
sig net.minecraft.tags.BlockSoundSetTags
member net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour$BlockStateBase sound|spawnAfterBreak|getDrops
member net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour$Properties sound
member net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block getDrops|dropResources|sound|playerDestroy
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity ^playStepSound$|^playMuffledStepSound$
calls net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block ^playerDestroy$|^dropResources$
# DyeColor kept only its id and name.
find Dye
member net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor dye
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Shulker colou?r|variant
# The worldgen debug tools.
sig net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.structure.StructureStart
member net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess biome
member net.minecraft.world.level.biome.BiomeSource debug|resolver
sig net.minecraft.world.level.biome.NoiseBiomeResolver
member net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.NoiseGeneratorSettings sea|aquifer|lava
findsig Speleothem
# Spawning the Ice Cube, and zombies freezing into frostbites.
member net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Monster spawn|dark
member net.minecraft.world.level.block.LevelEvent zombie|frostbite|drowned
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.zombie.Zombie onFreeze|[Ff]rost|[Cc]onvert
# The debug screen, rebuilt in 26.4-snapshot-2.
sig net.minecraft.client.gui.components.DebugScreenOverlay
calls net.minecraft.client.gui.components.DebugScreenOverlay ^extract
findsig components/debug/DebugColumn
# Projectiles: snowballs and ice balls share a base since 26.4-snapshot-3.
findsig ThrowableBallProjectile
sig net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.throwableitemprojectile.ThrowableItemProjectile
sig net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.throwableitemprojectile.Snowball
